back_translation: This is what the LORD says: Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there.
Say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah who sits on the throne of David—you, your officials, and your people who enter through these gates.

This is what the LORD says: Administer justice and righteousness. Rescue the one who has been robbed from the hand of the oppressor. Do not oppress or do violence to the foreigner, the orphan, or the widow, and do not shed the blood of the innocent in this place.

For if you indeed do according to this word, then kings who sit on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this palace, riding on chariots and horses—they, their officials, and their people.
But if you do not obey these words, I swear by myself, declares the LORD, that this palace will become a heap of ruins.
For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: You are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon; but I will surely make you a wilderness, cities where no one lives.
I will appoint destroyers against you, each with his weapons, and they will cut down your finest cedars and throw them into the fire.
Many nations will pass by this city and ask one another, Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?
Then they will answer, Because they forsook the covenant of the LORD their God and bowed down and served other gods.
Do not weep for the one who has died, nor mourn for him; but weep bitterly for the one who must go away, for he will not return to see the land of his birth again.
For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father and has gone out from this place: He will not return here again.
But he will die in the place to which he was carried into exile, and he will not see this land again.
Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness and his upper rooms by injustice, who makes his fellow countryman work without pay and does not give him his wages.
Who says, I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms—and cuts windows for it, panels it with cedar, and paints it with vermilion.
Does competing in cedar make you a king? Did not your father also eat and drink, and administer justice and righteousness? Then all went well for him.
He judged the cause of the poor and needy, and all went well. Is not this what it means to know me? declares the LORD.
But your eyes and your heart are fixed on one thing only—your dishonest gain, the shedding of innocent blood, and oppression and extortion.

Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: They will not mourn for him, Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister! and they will not mourn for him, Alas, lord! Alas, his majesty!
He will be buried as a donkey is buried—dragged off and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon and cry out; lift up your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are destroyed.
I warned you when you were at ease, but you said, I will not listen. This has been your way from your youth, that you have not obeyed my voice.
The wind will drive away all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity; then you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your wickedness.
O inhabitant of Lebanon, who nests among the cedars, how you will groan when pain comes upon you, anguish like a woman in labor.
As surely as I live, declares the LORD, even if Coniah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would pull you off from there.
I will hand you over to those who seek your life, into the hand of those you dread—into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Chaldeans.
I will hurl you and the mother who bore you into another land, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.
But the land to which they long to return, they will not return to it.
Is this man Coniah a despised and shattered pot, a vessel no one wants? Why are he and his offspring hurled out and cast into a land they do not know?
O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
This is what the LORD says: Enroll this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime; for none of his offspring will prosper to sit on the throne of David or rule again in Judah.
